routes.name: Short Stay eVisa
routes.summary: Online eVisa for tourism, business, visits and events. Apply at evisacam.cm, pay online, then enroll biometrics at the border or a Cameroon mission. Check the official portal for which passports are visa exempt.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months past travel date
Yellow fever certificate or signed medical exemption
Round-trip flight reservation and proof of funds
Tourism needs accommodation proof; visits need a police-legalized invitation letter
Visa-exempt nationalities were not confirmed from an official page

stay.note: Short stay validity is 1 to 180 days. Single or multiple entry is set by the issuing office.

steps: Fill in the application and upload documents
Get the authorization with QR code
Do biometrics (photo, fingerprints, signature) at the entry border post or a Cameroon mission

fees.label: Normal short stay (via embassy in US)
Express short stay (via embassy in US)
Normal short stay (via High Commission in UK)
Express short stay (via High Commission in UK)

routes.processing: Normal: up to 72 hours after payment. Express: up to 24 hours. Apply at least 10 days before travel.

sources.label: Cameroon High Commission UK, eVisa FAQ

routes.name: Transit eVisa
routes.summary: Transit visa for passing through Cameroon. You need a visa or entry permission for your final destination and an onward ticket. Airside transit rules were not confirmed.

other: Visa or entry authorization for the destination country
Airside transit exemptions not confirmed from an official page

stay.note: Up to 4 days is free per the US embassy document. UK page lists 4 to 30 days.

fees.label: Transit up to 4 days (via embassy in US)
Transit over 4 days (via embassy in US)
Transit 4 to 30 days (via High Commission in UK)

routes.processing: 1 to 3 business days per the US embassy document.

sources.label: Cameroon High Commission UK, eVisa FAQ

routes.name: Long Stay eVisa
routes.summary: Online visa for stays over 6 months: contract or independent work, long-term study or training, family of residents or citizens, and refugees. Valid up to about a year. Residence permit steps after arrival were not confirmed.

other: Study needs school letter and acceptance for a program over 6 months
Family needs proof of spouse or parent relationship to a Cameroonian citizen
Business needs company guarantee covering over 6 months

stay.note: Valid 181 to 360 days per the UK page.

fees.label: Long stay (via High Commission in UK)

routes.processing: About 3 business days per the US embassy document.

sources.label: Cameroon High Commission UK, eVisa FAQ
